title: Cartesian structure on sheaves over an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $B$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. In the category of fppf sheaves of sets on schemes over $S$, consider the slice category of sheaves equipped with a morphism to $B$. Equip this category with the cartesian monoidal structure whose unit is $B$ with its identity map, and whose tensor product of $F\to B$ and $H\to B$ is their sheaf fibre product $F\times_B H\to B$, with the usual projections and canonical associativity and unit isomorphisms. This is the ordinary finite-product structure on a slice category, specialized to sheaves over $B$.
